sents.en: The wind on the grassland is strong.
When the wind comes, all the grass moves.
The children learn to ride when they are very small.

sents.zh: 早上，他们和大人一起出去。
sents.en: In the morning they go out with the grown-ups.
Only in the evening do they come back.

sents.zh: 晚上的天比城里的天好看。
sents.en: The night sky there is finer than the sky in the city.

sents.zh: 他们在外面吃饭，也在外面唱歌。
sents.en: They eat outside and sing outside.
Life on the grassland is not easy.

sents.zh: 可是他们很爱这个地方。
sents.en: But they love this place very much.
